evidence: iZotope Neutron 5's Dynamic EQ element, twelve bands in real units (Hz, dB, Q) from its JSON state; a band's Enable is its existence. Shape indexes 0..12 as the Controls view's Shape popup lists them (walked top to bottom, `neutron-dial`, 2026-09-23): Proportional Q, Bell, Band Shelf, Analog / Baxandall / Vintage Low Shelf, Analog / Baxandall / Vintage High Shelf, Flat / Resonant Lowpass, Flat / Resonant Highpass — carried as the vocabulary shapes beside them, the three bell-like ones as bells, the three shelf designs as one shelf.
